newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Goodman applies to NZCC for Defiance clearance.
newsitem.headline: Goodman applies to NZCC for Defiance clearance.

text.p: The New Zealand Commerce Commission on Tuesday said it had registered an application from Goodman Fielder Ltd for clearance to acquire the New Zealand baking and milling assets of Defiance Mills Ltd.
The anti-monopolies Commission has 10 working days within which to make a decision, but allows for extensions of time if necessary.
New Zealand's Commerce Act prohibits business acquisitions that result in dominance being acquired or strengthened in any markets.

"The Commission will grant clearance if it is satisfied that dominance is not acquired or strengthened," the Commission said. Goodman said last week it believed it would win approval from the Commission to buy Defiance's New Zealand operations.
The agreed purchase price for the assets is NZ$48 million.
